title: Syrianus, Commentaries on Hermogenes' On Ideas and On Issues (In Hermogenem commentaria) / Сириан, Комментарии к Гермогену
author: Syrianus (Athenian Neoplatonist; attribution partly debated)
edition: Rabe, Syriani in Hermogenem commentaria I–II (Teubner 1892–93), public domain; raw Greek OCR on Lace.
ru_evidence: No Russian translation found: nothing in Russian Wikipedia; the ΣΧΟΛΗ article index (Neoplatonism-focused) shows none.
en_evidence: Only the introduction to On Ideas ('Syrianus'), in Baltzly & Share 2025, Ancient Commentators series (BMCR 2025.10.46). The commentaries proper: none found.
value: A Neoplatonist scholarch (Proclus' teacher) reads school rhetoric. Evidence for the canonisation of Hermogenes, Platonic theory of style, and lost rhetoricians. Specialists in rhetoric, Neoplatonism and Byzantine education.
ai_feasibility: Medium. Technical stasis and 'ideas' terminology needs a fixed glossary aligned with Heath, Wooten and Patillon. The repetitive lemma-and-comment structure suits AI.
pilot_unit: Commentary on On Ideas, opening section (Rabe vol. I, first about 40 pages), about 10,000 words.
